content: # /api/v1 run actions: approve, reject, resume, abort, PR, and the auto-PR loop ## What to build The write half of graph-manager's automation API for existing runs, in `apps/graph-manager/src/server`: | Method and path | Scope | Behaviour | |---|---|---| | `POST /api/v1/runs/:id/approve` | `runs:approve` | Only when the run is `awaiting-approval` (else 409). Resumes the engine with `--resume --run --approve-plan`. 200 + the run object | | `POST /api/v1/runs/:id/reject` | `runs:approve` | Body `{feedback}` (required, non-blank). Only in `awaiting-approval` (else 409). Writes the feedback to a file and resumes with `--resume --run --replan `. 200 + the run object | | `POST /api/v1/runs/:id/resume` | `runs:control` | Only `failed` or `aborted` (else 409). The existing resume (`resumeRun` in `routes/resume.ts`). 200 + the run object | | `POST /api/v1/runs/:id/abort` | `runs:control` | The existing abort: `POST /abort` on the run's live page (what the page's Abort button does). Not live → 409. 200 + the run object | | `POST /api/v1/runs/:id/pr` | `runs:pr` | Only `applied` (else 409). Starts the existing Create PR job (`startPr` in `pr.ts`) with the suggested branch `gm/`, title, body and base. `202 {job}` | Every handler is a plain function in a new `src/server/run-actions.ts`, shared by the v1 routes and by two new **cookie** routes for the UI: `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/approve` and `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/reject` (same handlers, same answers). Plus an **auto-PR loop**: every 15 s graph-manager looks at `apiRuns` entries with `openPr: true` whose run is `applied` and that have no PR, and starts Create PR **once** per run. A failure (refused or failed job) is logged, saved on the `apiRuns` entry as `prError` and shown on the run (run object `prError`, Runs list), and never retried by the loop. ### What is already in the code (dependencies) - **graph-manager resume helper** (`src/server/routes/resume.ts`, from the engine slice): `ResumeOptions` has `planArgs?: string[]` (exactly `["--approve-plan"]` or `["--replan", ]`); `resumeRun(ctx, ws, runId, { planArgs })` appends them after `--resume --run ` in both the sandbox and the local branch. A `--replan` path for a sandboxed run must be inside the workspace (pass it workspace-relative with `/`). `resumeRun` refuses only live runs (409) and `applied`/`done` (409); an `awaiting-approval` run has no live page because its process exited. - **Engine resume flags**: `graph-execution --resume --run --approve-plan` (an `awaiting-approval` run → `running`, then runs as usual) and `--resume --run --replan ` (appends the file's text to `state.plan.feedback`, sets `planning` and plans again). A plain `--resume` of an `awaiting-approval` run is a usage error. Exit codes: `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO` = 4, `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL` = 5; the run process exits at both (it never waits), and `needs-info` is final. Both work with `--web` and `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached` (launcher exits 0 once the run is up) and inside a sandbox container. The fake provider plans in tests. - **State** (`graph-execution/api`): `runStatusSchema` has `planning | needs-info | awaiting-approval`; `stateSchema.plan` = `{ contentPath, refs, gate, name?, attempts, questions, dropped, feedback: string[] }`. - **Tokens** (`src/server/auth.ts`): `requireScope(scope)` preHandler (403 `missing scope `), `apiAuthOf(req)`; bearer and cookie both work on `/api/v1/*`. - **v1 reads** (`src/server/v1-runs.ts`): `findRun(ctx, runId)` → `FoundRun = { ws, runId, summary, state? } | undefined`; `toRunObject(ctx, found)` → `{ runId, workspace, status, refs, questions, dropped, spec?, tasksDir?, viewUrl, pr?, error?, createdAt?, updatedAt? }` where `status` is mapped (`interrupted` → `failed`); `V1_STATUSES`. `src/server/runs.ts` exports `runSummaryOf(ws, runId, extras)` → `{ summary, state? } | undefined`, `readRunStateOf(ws, runId)`, `detailUrlOf`, `livePage(runDir)`, `runDirOf(ws, runId)`. - **v1 start** (`src/server/routes/v1.ts`, `src/server/inputs.ts`, `src/server/start-run.ts`, `src/server/store.ts`): `POST /api/v1/workspaces/:ws/runs`; `writeRunInputs(ctx, ws, runId, files: {name, text}[], sandboxed: boolean)` → `Record` (writes `/inputs//`, plus a copy in `/.graph-execution//inputs/` for a sandboxed run, whose path it then returns workspace-relative); store `apiRuns: Record<"/", { refs, openPr, idempotencyKey?, startedBy, createdAt }>`. `PATH_OPTIONS` in `sandbox-paths.ts` already maps `--replan` for Windows hosts. Tests in `src/server/routes/v1.start.test.ts` show how to start a fake planned run with the built engine and poll it to `awaiting-approval`. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.ts` (whole file, 118 lines) — `resumeRun(ctx, ws, runId, opts)` (35–89): refusals as `SandboxError(status, message, output?)`; the sandbox decision (line 44: `opts.sandbox === true || state.sandbox !== undefined || ctx.sandboxes?.recordOf(ws.id, runId) !== undefined`); sandbox args `["--resume", "--run", runId]` (55); local args `["--resume", "--run", runId, "--web"]` (71); the cookie route maps `SandboxError` to `{error, exitCode?, output?}` (96–108). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` — `prStatus` (153–169: `eligible`, `reason`, `suggested: { branch: "gm/", title, body, base, bases }`), `PrError` (71–79), `startPr(ctx, ws, runId, input)` (316–338) returns the `PrJob` and runs it in the background, `currentJob(ctx, ws, runId)` (311–313), `PrJob` (58–68: `status: "running" | "done" | "failed"`, `error?`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/pr.ts` (whole file) — the cookie Create PR route: `PrError` → `reply.code(err.status)`; success `202 { job }`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/proxy.ts` (36–65 `upstreamGetJson`; 86–99 how the target of a live run's page is found: `livePage(dir)`, `upstreamPort(web.url)`, `web.upstream ?? { host: "127.0.0.1", port }`, `Host: 127.0.0.1:`, the sandbox page token header `WEB_TOKEN_HEADER`). - `packages/graph-execution/src/web/server.ts` (line 219–223) — the run page's `POST /abort`: 200 `{ok:true}` while the run goes, 409 `{"error":"the run has ended"}` after. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (79–171) — `BuildAppOptions` (55–69), `onListen` / `onClose` hooks (124–136), route registration (144–157). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` — `apiRuns` (add `prAttempted`, `prError`), `prs`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (21–59 `RunSummary`, `SummaryExtras`; 243–277 `summarize`; 285–300 list functions) and `routes/runs.ts` (66–75 `GET /api/runs`). - Tests to mirror: `src/server/routes/resume.test.ts` (resume refusals with a written `state.json`, fake Docker for the sandbox branch), `src/server/routes/pr.test.ts` (lines 1–110: `startFakeForge()`, `appWithLogin({ githubApiUrl: forge.url + "/github" })`, `connect("github")`, `cloneWithRun(...)`, `waitForJob`), `src/server/routes/v1.start.test.ts` (real engine, fake provider). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` (113–140 `ActionCell`) and `src/web/types.ts` (`RunSummary`) — show `prError`. ## Patterns to follow **Action error (mirror SandboxError / PrError):** ```ts /** A refused or failed action: the HTTP status and the body to answer. */ export class ActionError extends Error { constructor(readonly status: number, message: string, readonly extra: { exitCode?: number; output?: string } = {}) { super(message); } } const send = (reply: FastifyReply, err: unknown) => { if (err instanceof ActionError) return reply.code(err.status).send({ error: err.message, ...err.extra }); throw err; }; ``` Map `SandboxError` from `resumeRun` to `ActionError(err.status, err.message, { exitCode?, output: lastLines(output, 20) })` exactly as `routes/resume.ts` 99–106 does, and `PrError` to `ActionError(err.status, err.message)`. **v1 route:** ```ts app.post<{ Params: { id: string } }>("/api/v1/runs/:id/approve", { preHandler: requireScope("runs:approve") }, async (req, reply) => { const found = isRunId(req.params.id) ? await findRun(ctx, req.params.id) : undefined; if (!found) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown run" }); try { return await approveRun(ctx, found); } catch (err) { return send(reply, err); } }); ``` ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `planArgs` already exists (see dependencies); do not add another option. Export `isSandboxedRun(ctx, ws, runId, state, opts?)` holding the sandbox-decision expression of `resumeRun` (originally line 44), and use it in `resumeRun`. Export `readRunState(runDir)` (20–29) too. - **GOTCHA**: the cookie route `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/resume` keeps passing no args; its tests (`resume.test.ts`) must pass unchanged. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/resume.test.ts` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/proxy.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export function upstreamPost(target, pathname, timeoutMs): Promise<{ status: number; body: unknown }>` (mirror `upstreamGetJson`: same Host and token headers, `method: "POST"`, `content-length: 0`, resolves with any status and the parsed JSON body or `undefined`), and `export async function pageTargetOf(runDir)` that returns the target exactly as lines 88–91 compute it (`undefined` when not live); use it in the proxy hook too. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: the `apiRuns` entry gets `prAttempted: z.boolean().optional()` (the auto-PR loop started or tried Create PR) and `prError: z.string().optional()` (why it failed). ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export async function startSuggestedPr(ctx, ws, runId): Promise`: `const st = await prStatus(ctx, ws, runId)`; none → `PrError(404, "unknown run")`; `st.pr` → `PrError(409, "the run already has a pull request")`; `!st.eligible || !st.suggested` → `PrError(409, st.reason ?? "the run can't get a pull request")`; else `startPr(ctx, ws, runId, { branch, title, body, base })` from `st.suggested`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/run-actions.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** (each takes a `FoundRun` and returns the fresh run object via `toRunObject(ctx, (await findRun(ctx, runId)) ?? found)` unless noted): - `approveRun(ctx, found)`: `status` (from `toRunObject`) must be `awaiting-approval`, else `ActionError(409, "the run is not awaiting approval (status " + status + ")")`. Then `resumeRun(ctx, ws, runId, { planArgs: ["--approve-plan"] })`. - `rejectRun(ctx, found, feedback)`: same 409 rule. `n = (found.state?.plan?.feedback.length ?? 0) + 1`; `const paths = await writeRunInputs(ctx, ws, runId, [{ name: "feedback-" + n + ".md", text: feedback }], isSandboxedRun(ctx, ws, runId, found.state))`; then `resumeRun(ctx, ws, runId, { planArgs: ["--replan", paths["feedback-" + n + ".md"]] })` (for a sandboxed run `writeRunInputs` returns the workspace-relative copy under `.graph-execution//inputs/`, as the sandbox requires). - `resumeApiRun(ctx, found)`: status must be `failed` or `aborted` (the mapped status, so an interrupted run counts as failed), else `ActionError(409, "the run can't be resumed (status )")`. Then `resumeRun(ctx, ws, runId)`. - `abortRun(ctx, found)`: `const target = await pageTargetOf(runDirOf(ws, runId))`; none → `ActionError(409, "the run is not live")`. `const res = await upstreamPost(target, "/abort", 10_000)`; `res.status === 409` → `ActionError(409, body.error ?? "the run has ended")`; other non-2xx → `ActionError(502, "the run's page did not accept the abort")`; network error → 502 `the run's page did not answer`. - `startApiRunPr(ctx, found)`: status must be `applied`, else `ActionError(409, "the run has not landed (status )")`; then `startSuggestedPr` (map `PrError`); returns the `PrJob`. - **GOTCHA**: `resumeRun` throws `SandboxError(409, "the run is live")` for a live run and `SandboxError(400, …, output)` when the engine refuses; pass those through as ActionErrors with the same status. - **IMPORTS**: `resumeRun, isSandboxedRun` from `./routes/resume.js`; `SandboxError` from `./sandbox-run.js`; `PrError, startSuggestedPr, type PrJob` from `./pr.js`; `pageTargetOf, upstreamPost` from `./proxy.js`; `writeRunInputs` from `./inputs.js`; `findRun, toRunObject, type FoundRun, type RunObject` from `./v1-runs.js`; `runDirOf` from `./runs.js`; `lastLines` from `./start-run.js`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/v1.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: the five routes from the table with their scopes. `reject` body: `z.object({ feedback: z.string().trim().min(1, "feedback is required").max(200_000) })` → a blank feedback is `400 {"error":"feedback: feedback is required"}`. `pr` answers `202 { job }`; the others `200` + run object. Unknown or invalid id → `404 {"error":"unknown run"}`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (or a new `routes/approvals.ts` registered in app.ts) - **IMPLEMENT**: cookie routes for the UI with the same handlers: `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/approve` and `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/reject {feedback}`. Resolve the workspace (`404 unknown workspace`), build the `FoundRun` with `runSummaryOf(ws, runId, { prs, dataDir })` (`404 unknown run`), call `approveRun` / `rejectRun`, answer `200` + run object or the `ActionError`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/autopr.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: ```ts export const AUTO_PR_MS = 15_000; /** * One pass of the auto-PR loop: for each apiRuns entry with openPr, no stored PR and no earlier attempt whose run is * `applied`, mark it attempted and start Create PR with the suggested values. A refusal, or a job that ended failed, * is saved as `prError` and logged; it is never tried again by the loop. */ export async function autoPrTick(ctx: AppContext, log: (msg: string) => void = console.warn): Promise /** Runs autoPrTick every `ms` (unref'd timer; ticks never overlap). Returns stop(). */ export function startAutoPr(ctx: AppContext, ms = AUTO_PR_MS, log?: (msg: string) => void): () => void ``` Per entry `key = "/"` (the ws id never contains `/`): skip when `!rec.openPr` or `ctx.store.get().prs[key]`. If `rec.prAttempted`: when `!rec.prError` and `currentJob(ctx, ws, runId)?.status === "failed"`, store `prError = job.error ?? "Create PR failed"` and log; continue. Else read `readRunStateOf(ws, runId)`; only when `state?.status === "applied"`: `await ctx.store.update((d) => { const r = d.apiRuns[key]; if (r) r.prAttempted = true; })`, then `startSuggestedPr(ctx, ws, runId)`; on any error store `prError = err.message` and `log("auto PR for failed: ")`. - **GOTCHA**: never log a forge token (PrError messages are already scrubbed). Unknown workspace / missing run folder → skip silently. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `BuildAppOptions.autoPrMs?: number | false` (default `AUTO_PR_MS`; `false` = off). In an `onListen` hook start `startAutoPr(ctx, ms, (m) => app.log.warn(m))` (and run one tick at once); stop it in `onClose`. Register `run-actions`' cookie routes if you put them in a new module. - **GOTCHA**: `app.inject` never fires `onListen`, so inject-only tests never run the loop; a test that wants it calls `app.listen({ port: 0, host: "127.0.0.1" })` with a small `autoPrMs`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/v1-runs.ts`, `runs.ts`, `routes/runs.ts`, web `types.ts`, `pages/Runs.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: run object gets `prError?: string` from `apiRuns[key].prError`. `SummaryExtras` gets `apiRuns?: Record`; `summarize` sets `summary.prError`; `GET /api/runs` passes `ctx.store.get().apiRuns`. Web `RunSummary.prError?: string`; `ActionCell` shows `auto PR failed` for an applied run without `pr` that has `prError` (before the Create PR button logic, which still shows when eligible). ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/v1.actions.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - Without the engine (`appWithLogin()`, a workspace with `git init`, `state.json` written with `stateSchema.parse` as in `resume.test.ts` 30–46, tokens via `POST /api/tokens`): - `approve` on an `applied` run → 409; on a `failed` run → 409; `reject` with `{feedback:" "}` → 400; `reject` on a `running` run → 409. - `resume` on an `applied` / `awaiting-approval` run → 409. - `abort` on a run that is not live → 409 `the run is not live`. - `pr` on a `failed` run → 409 `the run has not landed (status failed)`. - Scopes: a `runs:read` token on approve → 403 `{"error":"missing scope runs:approve"}`; on resume → 403 `missing scope runs:control`; on pr → 403 `missing scope runs:pr`. Unknown id → 404. - Cookie routes `POST /api/runs///approve` and `/reject` give the same 409/400 answers. - With the built engine (`it.skipIf(!built)`, setup as `src/server/routes/v1.start.test.ts`): start `{content, provider:"fake", sandbox:false}` → poll to `awaiting-approval` → `POST /api/v1/runs//reject {feedback:"Use blue"}` → 200; `/inputs//feedback-1.md` holds `Use blue`; poll until `awaiting-approval` again and `state.plan.feedback` (read `state.json`) contains `Use blue` → `approve` → 200 → poll until `applied`; `approve` again → 409. Close the run page at the end (`POST /runs///view/close`) and kill pids as runs.test.ts does. - Abort with the built engine: start a run whose task hangs (`GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT` with `{"task:1":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}}` in the server's env, see TESTING.md; gate `"auto"`), poll until `running` and live, `POST /api/v1/runs//abort` → 200, poll until `aborted`. If the planned task id is not `1` in the fake planner, read the task id from the planned task folder first; skip this case if it can't be made deterministic. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.actions.test.ts` ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/autopr.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** (mirror `routes/pr.test.ts` 1–78: fake forge, `connect("github")`, `cloneWithRun("github", "octo/hello", runId, "applied")`, then write a changed file in the clone so `prStatus` finds uncommitted changes): - Seed `apiRuns["github~octo~hello/"] = { refs: [], openPr: true, startedBy: "admin", createdAt: "x" }`; build the app with `autoPrMs: 50` and `listen`, or call `autoPrTick(ctx)` if you expose the context; poll until `store.get().prs[key]` exists and `GET /api/v1/runs/` (cookie) has `pr.url`. `prAttempted` is true. - Without a connected forge: one tick stores `prError` (contains `not connected`) and `prAttempted: true`; after connecting the forge and more ticks, still no PR (not retried) and the same `prError`; the run object and `GET /api/runs` summary carry `prError`. - An entry with `openPr: false`, or a run that is `awaiting-approval`, is left alone. - **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/autopr.test.ts` ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/README.md` - **IMPLEMENT**: a `## Automation API` section before `## Security`: create a token in Settings → API tokens (scopes list with one line each), the endpoints table (method, path, scope, behaviour) from this task and `POST /api/v1/workspaces/:ws/runs` / `GET /api/v1/runs[/:id]` / `GET /api/v1/workspaces` / `GET /api/v1/ping`, the run object JSON, the statuses, `openPr` and the auto-PR rule, `idempotencyKey`, `sandbox` defaulting to true, and a curl example: ```bash curl -s -H "authorization: Bearer $GM_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"content":"# Add a health endpoint\n…","refs":[{"ref":"KAN-41","url":"https://…/KAN-41"}],"openPr":true}' \ http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/v1/workspaces/github~octo~hello/runs curl -s -H "authorization: Bearer $GM_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/v1/runs/ curl -s -X POST -H "authorization: Bearer $GM_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/v1/runs//approve ``` ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `approve` on a run that isn't `awaiting-approval` → 409; on one that is → 200, and the run goes `running` → `applied`. - [ ] `reject {feedback}` → 200, the run plans again and `state.plan.feedback` contains the text; blank feedback → 400; not awaiting → 409. - [ ] `resume` only for `failed`/`aborted` (else 409); `abort` of a live run → 200 and the run ends `aborted`; of a non-live run → 409; `pr` only for `applied` (else 409) → `202 {job}`. - [ ] Scopes: approve/reject `runs:approve`, resume/abort `runs:control`, pr `runs:pr`; a token without it → 403 `missing scope `. - [ ] The cookie routes `POST /api/runs/:ws/:runId/approve|reject` use the same handlers. - [ ] With `openPr: true` and a connected forge, an applied API run gets a PR without a click (fake forge); a failure is saved as `prError`, shown on the run, and not retried. - [ ] README has the Automation API section with token setup and a curl example. - [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager` ## Validation commands ```bash npm run build -w graph-execution npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/v1.actions.test.ts src/server/autopr.test.ts src/server/routes/resume.test.ts src/server/routes/pr.test.ts src/server/proxy.test.ts npm test -w graph-manager ```
